label: Late-episode D1 after an unrewarded rare a1->S2 trial
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass), almost only when the reward input is 0 (99% of mass), and only in the last ~20 trials of the episode (trials 80-99; 84% of mass in 90-99, none before trial 79). The previous trial was nearly always a1 with a rare transition to S2 (86% of mass; the rest is the window first trial, where prev_common is unknown). So the previous trial was rare-unrewarded, and a model-based agent should repeat a1. The policy logit at these steps favors a1 (choice 2.8-8) and value is low. Dev F1 0.62 (P 0.51, R 0.78, mass recall 0.84). Every variable in the predicate is observed at D1, so it uses no future variables. Main failures: many D1 steps that match the predicate stay silent (precision about 0.5), and the cutoff on episode trial is soft. Low-activation misses are D1 r0 steps after other trial types, e.g. a common a1 trial, and window-start steps whose previous trial is unknown. The pattern is late in the episode, prev unrewarded, prev a1-rare. It never fires at GO or D2, after a rewarded trial, or after an a2 choice. Swapping the trial cutoff for low value gives similar F1, so magnitude may track value or episode time, but I did not check that.
